newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama's phone sale privatization set for May 20.
newsitem.headline: Panama's phone sale privatization set for May 20.

text.p: Panama will auction 49 percent of state telephone company INTEL on May 20, a top government official said Friday.
"We're planning a public act May 20 for the sale of 49 percent of INTEL," Planning and Economic Policy Ministry chief of staff Juan Francisco Aleman told Reuters.
Cable and Wireless Plc and GTE Corp are the only companies that have qualified to bid. "Both companies agreed to the concession contract Thursday," Aleman said.
Although INTEL is said to be worth some $2 billion in total, he said the government would not disclose estimates of its value "and does not associate itself with previous price quotes."
